description: acme/weather-widget 2.0.0 is installed from the `verified` channel, raising the resolved-version high-water mark for (acme/weather-widget, verified) to 2.0.0. The pack is then uninstalled, which removes its own pack-owned state including its install records, and a channel pointer naming 1.0.0 is resolved again for a fresh install. The high-water mark is NOT pack-owned state — it is the verifier's memory of what it has EVER resolved (MKT-050) — so it survives the uninstall exactly as it survives a restart (channel-index/1 CHI-062), and the downgrade is still refused POINTER_ROLLBACK_REJECTED. Clearing it with the pack would make uninstall-then-reinstall a sanctioned downgrade path in which every individual step succeeds.

expected.append_only: one record per successfully applied install; a refused install appends none
